rationale: PROBE, not a proposal. Re-declares the project's EXISTING hand-built one-hot domain_b (experiments/fsm_reencode/) as a gate proposal, to test prediction R2: that gate_proposal.py rejects it at G3 for changing the flop count at k=0, and therefore that no FSM re-encoding could ever have been submitted through the gate. The variant RTL is unchanged and already committed.
